metadata.provenance: Hand-labelled synthetic derived values; no prompts, source rows, customer data, or live telemetry.
metadata.weightAssumption: No evidence source is averaged or weighted. Baseline and comparability are hard gates; coverage and sample size select an evidence-completeness band.
metadata.prohibitedWordingAssumption: No verdict may claim the tracked action produced the change. The contract measures direction only, so this wording is prohibited in every fixture, not only where comparability, sampling, or baseline evidence is absent.

fixtures.permittedWording: Measured recoverable spend is lower than the prior baseline.
fixtures.assumption: A decrease of at least 5% is material; 95% coverage and ten or more rows meet the high-completeness convention.

fixtures.assumption: Local evidence is read back from storage a visitor can edit. A coverage figure outside 0–100 is a corrupted record rather than measured attribution, so completeness is reported as missing instead of letting an impossible number buy high confidence.
